newsitem.title: FRANCE: Peugeot not certain of 1997 profitability.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot not certain of 1997 profitability.

text.p: PSA Peugeot Citroen chairman Jacques Calvet said on Thursday he was not absolutely certain the French carmaker would be profitable in 1997.
Asked whether he expected the company to be profitable this year, Calvet said "Are we 100 pct sure? the answer is no." But he said one of the company's objectives was to be profitable in 1997.
Calvet was speaking at a news conference following the release of Peugeot's 1996 results earlier which showed a 57 percent drop in net profit to 734 million francs.
